nodes.text: There’s no specific treatment for #HMPV, just like with most viral colds. Treatment involves managing your symptoms, such as getting plenty of rest and taking medicine for pain or fever. If your symptoms last more than 3-5 days or get worse, see a doctor or go to a clinic. https://t.co/l8VVnULvog
